def transform(grid):
    # Extend the diagonal sequence of 1s in its observed direction to the grid boundary.
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(pts) >= 2:
        (r0, c0), (r1, c1) = sorted(pts)
        dr = 1 if r1 > r0 else -1 if r1 < r0 else 0
        dc = 1 if c1 > c0 else -1 if c1 < c0 else 0
        if dr and dc:
            r, c = r1 + dr, c1 + dc
            while 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):
                out[r][c] = 1
                r += dr
                c += dc
    return out
